architecturalApproximation.sourceFacts: Arup engineer Tristram Carfrae describes177×177×31m,about4000 inflated ETFE pillows,some spanning9m,and repeated seven roof/fifteen wall types in a Weaire-Phelan foam structure.
architecturalApproximation.material: Original irregular Voronoi-derived pillow/seam/colour/roughness/tangent-normal material,32m UV repeat with about six cells across (~5.3m representative cell). No external photo pixels embedded.
architecturalApproximation.groundStorey: Two open photographs were actually viewed: a daylight exterior and the2008 illuminated facade. Both show a recessed glazed entrance storey and pale columns beneath the ETFE facade; these architectural layers are now present. The4.2m entrance-storey height,1.8m recess,12m pale-column spacing and extension around unshown elevations are inferred rather than surveyed.

architecturalApproximation.visualVerification: Macro-scale colour seams and pillow normals were rebaked for this model. Actual open-photo pixels subsequently resolved the missing recessed glazed ground storey, which was added while retaining177×177×31m. Source-preview comparison recorded separately.

openPhotos.scope: Daylight exterior: irregular inflated ETFE cells, seams, recessed glazed entrance strip and pale columns; not surveyed dimensions or every elevation.
2008 night facade: entrance-storey recession and pale columns; coloured event lighting is historical and is not treated as normal current colour.
